content: द्वय {%a.%} (-यी|{%f.%}) .²1 Two-fold, double, of two kinds or sorts; अनुपेक्षणे द्वयी गतिः <ls>Mu. 3</ls>; कुसुमस्तबकस्येव द्वयी वृत्तिर्मनस्विनः . मूर्ध्नि वा सर्वलोकस्य विशीर्येत वनेऽथवा .. <ls>Bh. 2. 104</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>); sometimes used in <ab>pl.</ab> also; see <ls>Śi. 3. 57</ls>. .²2 Relating to द्वैत (<ab>q. v.</ab>); अविद्यमानोऽप्यवभाति हि द्वयः <ls>Bhāg. 11. 2. 38</ls>. .{@-यम्@} .²1 Pair, couple, brace (usually at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); द्वितयेन द्वयमेव संगतम् <ls>R. 8. 6</ls>, <ls n="R.">1. 19</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 8</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 4</ls>. .²2 Two-fold nature, duplicity. .²3 Untruthfulness. .²4 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The masculine and feminine gender. .{@-यी@} A pair, couple.
